content:
The incident was caused by the **/var partition filling up because the system journal had no size limit**.  
`/var/log/journal` grew unchecked, filling the root disk, which produced ENOSPC errors (e.g., “no space left on device” when trying to write the shell history). The fix was to vacuum the journal and add a `SystemMaxUse=500M` limit in `/etc/systemd/journald.conf`.
